topic: JCDecaux India impression data transfer status
summary_markdown:
The discussion concerns the updated impression data for JCDecaux India (7898), specifically regarding historical impressions from 2025-02-26 that were supposedly fixed and recalculated. The core issue is whether this data needs to be reloaded into DataCorp.

[p1] initially questioned who was responsible for the transfer process, noting a previous assumption that all JCDecaux accounts were sent data.
[p2] clarified that the practice of sending all data to the Danish account has stopped; currently, only Denmark's data is transferred there. 
[p3] confirmed that India is not included in the current data transfer scope.
decisions: JCDecaux India impression data does not need to be reloaded into DataCorp.
action_items: [me] will check on the data reloading process later, potentially coordinating with 'Afa'.
